text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient did not mention a sore throat."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":25,"why":"The patient mentioned using an inhaler for asthma."},{"i":2,"v":"INFERRED","u":37,"why":"The patient reported cough, fever, and shortness of breath, which are consistent with having colds and coughs and a fever."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":39,"why":"The patient stated that walking to work is difficult due to shortness of breath."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":42,"why":"The patient explicitly stated 'No chest pain'."},{"i":5,"v":"INFERRED","u":58,"why":"The patient mentioned using salbutamol for asthma, which is a common asthma inhaler."},{"i":6,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient reported a fever of 37°C, which is not considered high."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":76,"why":"The patient explicitly stated 'No, no allergies'."},{"i":8,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient reported drinking alcohol only occasionally, not regularly."}]}
